author: Karl Rock
description:
If you’re a foreigner travelling through Pakistan, especially in areas that see fewer international tourists, you may naturally attract a bit of curiosity and attention.

One thing I’ve found helpful is wearing a shalwar kameez. It’s comfortable, appropriate for the local culture, and can help you blend in a little more while travelling.

Of course, there’s nothing wrong with people being curious - for me, it’s simply about feeling more comfortable, respecting the local culture, and enjoying the experience without standing out quite as much.

A small change that can make travelling Pakistan feel a lot easier.
title: How to Avoid Attention in Pakistan
